name: tfl_bikepoint_docking_stations
title: Santander Cycles docking stations (TfL BikePoint)
description: Every Santander Cycles docking station in TfL's live BikePoint list — around 800 stations — with TfL's id and terminal number, name, location, number of docks, status flags and install date. TfL publishes current state only: stations that are removed, renamed or moved disappear from or change in the list with no public record. This table is a weekly copy of the list's inventory; the monthly archive-YYYY-MM tags preserve the network as it stood each month. Powered by TfL Open Data.

sources.title: Transport for London — Unified API, BikePoint endpoint (api.tfl.gov.uk/BikePoint)

update_cadence: TfL's API is live and changes whenever docking stations are added, removed, moved or resized; copied here weekly, so changes between copies are visible at weekly resolution.
caveats: This is a weekly copy of a live list. A station added and removed within the same week never appears, and dates of change are known only to within a week (or to within a month from the archive tags).

TfL has reused old BikePoint ids for new stations elsewhere in London, so an id is not a permanent identifier across years. Names are unique within any one copy of the list and are what TfL's cycle hire journey files use.
Names are TfL's, verbatim, including stray spaces before commas (e.g. 'River Street , Clerkenwell') — the same spelling as in TfL's journey files.

nb_docks is TfL's reported total docks at the station, which changes when a station is expanded or reduced (about 3% of stations over 18 months to November 2026). Live bike and free-dock counts are not in this table: a single reading per week is not a meaningful measure of availability. They are in the raw zip for anyone who wants them.
install_date is missing for around 90 stations. A few stations still listed carry a removal_date (in 2018) — this is TfL's data as published, not corrected here.
Dates are UTC; TfL sends them as epoch milliseconds, so a station installed at midnight UK summer time appears at 23:00 the previous day.
History starts with the first copy here (November 2026). For earlier states of the list, the Internet Archive holds occasional copies of the API response from 2015 onwards.

Attribution required by the licence: "Powered by TfL Open Data". The licence also asks re-users to acknowledge Ordnance Survey derived data where present ("Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database rights 2016" and Geomni UK Map data © and database rights [2019]).

resources.name: docking_stations_parquet
resources.description: One row per docking station in TfL's list at fetch time, sorted by the numeric part of bikepoint_id. Inventory only (no live counts). Derived from the raw zip, which is authoritative.

fields.name: bikepoint_id
fields.description: TfL's BikePoint id, e.g. 'BikePoints_1'. Not permanent: TfL has reused ids for new stations.

fields.name: terminal_name
fields.description: TfL's terminal number for the station, a six-digit string with leading zeros (e.g. '001023').

fields.name: name
fields.description: Station name as published by TfL, verbatim (usually 'Street, Area').

fields.name: nb_docks
fields.description: Total docks at the station as reported by TfL at fetch time.

fields.name: locked
fields.description: TfL's Locked flag (station not available for hire or return).

fields.name: temporary
fields.description: TfL's Temporary flag (e.g. event or works stations).

fields.name: install_date
fields.description: Install date-time, ISO 8601 UTC (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ); null where TfL gives none.

fields.name: removal_date
fields.description: Removal date-time, ISO 8601 UTC; null for almost all stations.

resources.name: raw_zip
resources.description: TfL's API response exactly as returned (BikePoint.json), in one deterministic zip. Includes the live bike and free-dock counts at fetch time.
